text: そんなん　いうても　ポケモン　もちきれへんやんけ！

structure.jp: そんなん　いうても
ポケモン　もちきれへんやんけ！
structure.en: you can't carry any more Pokémon, can you!

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: ても after a verb means 'even if' or 'even though'. いうて is the Kansai way of saying いって. そんなん　いうても = 'even if you say that'.

patterns.name: 〜きれない
patterns.explanation: きれない added to a verb says you can't do it all the way, there is too much. へん is the Kansai form of ない. もちきれへん = 'can't carry them all'.

patterns.name: 〜じゃないか
patterns.explanation: やんけ is rough Kansai speech for じゃないか, pushing a point the listener should already see. もちきれへんやんけ = 'you can't carry them all, can you!'.
